reading.title: Talking About a Book
reading.purpose: Hear two friends talk about the parts of a book.
paras: Dev says, "Look at the title. It says Duck Wants a Boat." Mei says, "Who is the character?"
Dev says, "A duck is the character. On this page, the duck has a problem." Mei says, "Turn the page! I want a surprise."

qs.q: A character is a person or animal in a story. Who is the character?
qs.why: Dev says a duck is the character.

qs.q: What does the duck have on this page?
qs.why: Dev says the duck has a problem on this page.

qs.q: What does Mei want to find when she turns the page?
qs.why: Mei says, "Turn the page! I want a surprise."

reading.retellFrame: The title of the book is ___.
